review_scope: Frozen public capture/read/write/mechanical tool code, synthetic privacy boundaries, ranges, hash/completeness truthfulness, and operation receipt stages. Route/SDK/context closure and process/whole-case lifecycle are owned by separate checkers.

tests.scope: Synthetic fixtures only. Four local MCP tool-server processes are mechanical namespace tests, not native candidate starts.

verified_properties: Read namespace restricts access to admitted case inputs/out/TASK and verified content-addressed capture bodies; receipts and capture metadata are not model-readable.
Absolute/traversal/noncanonical paths, symlinks, hardlinks, special files and oversized inputs fail closed; synthetic private/evaluator/sibling paths denied in actual local bwrap MCP tests.
Writes and enumerated mechanical outputs are exclusive creates under out; public capture bodies cannot be overwritten through admitted tools.
Public GET permits URL only, HTTPS port 443, solely global unicast DNS answers, checked-IP TCP pin and hostname-verifying TLS; no caller auth/headers/proxy/body or alternate ports.
Exact bounded raw HTTP body prefix, content address, source version, HTTP status, actual URL, truncation and incomplete-body flags remain distinguishable.
Delivered source ranges and transmitted text have separate hashes and byte counts; invalid UTF-8 replacement and line formatting do not silently become exact source bytes.
Operation receipts bind argument hash, operation identity, elapsed cost and exact RPC envelope across operation-started/prepared-result/stdout-flushed.
Prepared-result evidence is required before stdout; receipt capacity prevents unrecorded response, and broken stdout creates no flush witness.
conditions_before_actual_use: Pinned adapter/server selection and route closure must independently pass; this review does not establish suppression of every general host filesystem/execution tool in the native client.

Only declared per-case public inputs/TASK/out/capture/receipt directories may be supplied. Host input selection and case admission must exclude credentials, evaluator keys, private corpora and sibling cases.
Whole-case lifecycle/accounting limits must independently pass and root/operator must explicitly admit a bounded new canary.
Actual native/public GET/range delivery and context closure require separate new canary evidence. No previous native proof or old closure qualification is inherited.
evidence_interpretation: stdout-flushed proves only tool-server stdout write/flush; frontend receipt and model consumption are unobserved.
A GET or capture hash establishes mechanical capture, not semantic acquisition or a true finding.
complete_source_delivered describes the admitted captured bytes and exact UTF-8 delivery; HTTP completeness/truncation and prior/following range coverage must be checked separately.
Invalid UTF-8 can expand replacement text beyond the requested source-byte count; raw and transmitted hashes/byte counts explicitly distinguish this.
Host immutability is not claimed: a privileged host can mutate its own files, while public-body reads detect content-address mismatch.
excluded_actions: No credentials, private host inventory, evaluator keys, raw native logs, private corpus or old candidate bodies read.
No old v7 code read and no canonical/main/Git edits.
handoff: Root/operator and execution checker may use this exact frozen receipt only for conditional canary admission. A fresh independent grader must assess actual new canary proof without repeating the whole source audit.
